en.answer: Pendulum Monster Cards on the field that would be sent to the Graveyard are placed face-up in the Extra Deck instead. Therefore, when activating the effect of <<12363>> that Special Summons a Dragon Lord Token, you cannot send a Pendulum Monster to the Graveyard.
en.question: Can the effect of <<12363>> that Special Summons a Dragon Lord Token be activated by sending a Pendulum Monster to the Graveyard?
